notes.title: Regular updates and official release notes 22-10-01
notes.content:
This update adds dialogue content and fixes several bugs.
About the official version
1. The official version will be launched after it is completely ready. The high-intensity development during the period when the early access version is launched is exhausting, and there are no boundaries between life and work. Compromises were made on the quality of the game due to the rush. Of course this is not possible, I hope this game is an amazing work. Therefore, we decided to extend the launch time of the official version until we are truly satisfied, and hereby apologize to the players who have been pushing the pace.
2. The official version will open the operation module of company operation and listing. This series involves a lot, and I hope that there will be enough time to improve it.
3. I hope to complete the work on the premise of ensuring physical and mental health! Hope you all pay attention to work-life balance! Have fun in this world!

notes.title: small update
notes.content:
Extend the age limit of the game to 45 years old, optimize the stock price fluctuation mechanism, optimize the description of the mortgage reminder, modify the events after the schedule, and fix a number of bugs.
The company's financing and listing process will be launched in the next major version, and performance optimization will be carried out.

notes.title: “The Few”Early Access is available now
notes.content:
Added year-end competition, salary increase mechanism and investment probability, fixed some bugs.
As an independent game developer, it takes a lot of time and energy to develop a game on your own. I hope that I can communicate with players through the early experience mode, get feedback, and make the game more popular with players. The Early Access state will continue for some time.
